{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
# Remove commas and convert to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean age of customers in completed orders (excluding age = -1)
mean_age = completed_orders[completed_orders['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age'].mean()

mean_age"}
